column2: Pergamon is an ancient city in the Bergama district of İzmir, dating to the 8th century BC and part of a World Heritage Site (2014).
Mount Nemrut in Adıyaman province is a mountain and World Heritage Site (1987); the protected area is 11 ha.
Nicomedia is an ancient city in Yalova province, dating to 264 BC and named after Nicomedes I.
Edessa is an ancient city in Şanlıurfa province, dating to 302 BC and also known as Vodina.
Tigranocerta in Diyarbakır is an ancient city dating to 78 BC.
Priene in Aydın is an archaeological site dating to 1000 BC and on the World Heritage Tentative List (2018).
Perge in Antalya is an archaeological site dating to 1000 BC and on the World Heritage Tentative List (2009).
Knidos in the Datça district of Muğla is a settlement dating to 1100 BC.
Heraclea Pontica in the Karadeniz Ereğli district of Zonguldak is an archaeological site dating to 558 BC.
The Sokollu Mehmed Pasha Mosque in Fatih is an Ottoman complex from 1665, designed by Mimar Sinan, and a protected cultural property.
The Serpent Column in İstanbul is a sculpture dating to the 5th century BC and part of a World Heritage Site.
Phaselis in the Kemer district of Antalya is an archaeological site dating to 700 BC.
Yazılıkaya in Çorum is an archaeological site dating to the 13th century BC and part of a World Heritage Site (1986); its area is 1.8 ha.
Dara in Mardin is an archaeological site dating to 505.
Zeugma in Gaziantep is an ancient city dating to the 3rd century BC, said to have been founded by Seleucus I, and is on the World Heritage Tentative List (2012).
Mor Gabriel Monastery in the Midyat district of Mardin is a monastery from 397.
The Emir Sultan Mosque in the Yıldırım district of Bursa is an Ottoman mosque from 1868, commissioned by Fatma Hundi Hatun and named after Emir Sultan.
Yoros Castle in Beykoz is a ruined Byzantine fortress from 1262.
The Cathedral of Kars (Kümbet Mosque) is an Armenian church commissioned by Abas I.
The Kara Ahmed Pasha Mosque in Fatih is an Ottoman work by Mimar Sinan from 1572, also known as the Gazi Ahmed Pasha Mosque.
The Mor Hananyo Monastery (Deyrulzafarân) in Mardin is a monastery from 493.
Zerzevan Castle in the Çınar district of Diyarbakır is an archaeological site dating to the 4th century; its area is 5.7 ha and it is on the World Heritage Tentative List (2020).
Varagavank (Yedi Kilise) in Van is a monastery commissioned by Nerses III, from 653, with Armenian architecture.
Hoşap Castle in the Gürpınar district of Van is a castle dating to 1643.

The Sokollu Mehmed Pasha Mosque in Lüleburgaz, Kırklareli, is an Ottoman building from 1569, commissioned by Sokollu Mehmed Pasha and designed by Mimar Sinan; it has been protected as a cultural property since 1991.
Heraclea at Latmus is an ancient city in Caria, in the Milas district of Muğla.
The Amastrianum in İstanbul is a square.
The Latin Catholic Cathedral of the Annunciation in the İskenderun district of Hatay is a cathedral.
Opiza Monastery in Artvin is a church named after John.
The Kızılırmak Delta in Samsun is a delta covering 21,514 ha; it is a Ramsar site (1998), an important bird area, and on the World Heritage Tentative List.
Celaenae in Afyonkarahisar is a city.
The Mausoleum of Mahmud II in Fatih is a tomb from 1840, designed by Mimar Kemaleddin Bey.
The Kesik Minare in Antalya is a mosque from the 7th century, with Byzantine and Ottoman architecture.
Kars Castle in Kars is a castle dating to 1153.
Ayanis Fortress in Van is a fortification.
Pepuza is an ancient city in the Phrygia region of Anatolia, in Uşak province.
Kalepark in Trabzon is a fortress.

The Sultan Bayezid II Complex in Edirne is an Islamic and Ottoman complex from the 1480s, commissioned by Bayezid II and designed by Mimar Hayreddin; it is on the World Heritage Tentative List (2016).
The Eghegnamor Monastery (Çengilli Church) in Kars is a monastery from the 11th century.
Cafer Höyük in Malatya is an archaeological site dating to 7110 BC.
The Florya Atatürk Marine Mansion in Bakırköy is a house museum in Bauhaus style, designed by Seyfi Arkan and from 1993.
Tushhan (Ziyaret Tepe) in Diyarbakır is a settlement mound.
Agarak Monastery in Iğdır is an Armenian monastery from the 7th century, built by Nerses III.
Šinahuttum in Çorum is a city.
Cedrae is an ancient settlement in Caria, in the Ula district of Muğla.
The Dolishane Church (Doliskana) in Kilis is a monastery from the 10th century.
Mardin Castle in Mardin is a citadel.
Loulon in Niğde is a fortification.
Bezabde in Şırnak is a castrum.
The Monastery of Saint Minas of Kes (Surp Minas Church) in Erzurum is a building from 1790.
Afyonkarahisar Castle in Afyonkarahisar is a castle dating to 1350.
Parkhali (Parhali) Monastery in Artvin is a monastery from 973.
The Gümüşler Monastery in Niğde is a church.
The Temple of the Emperors (Ephesus), also called the Temple and Altar of the Emperors with the Domitian Terrace, in İzmir is an archaeological site.
The Saint Grigor Monastery (Aghkaberd, Ani) in Kars is a church.
Şavşat Castle (Satleli) in Artvin is a castle.
Sura is an archaeological site and ancient city in Lycia, in the Demre area of Antalya.
The Medrese Ali Bey Mosque in Edirne is a mosque in Ottoman style.
The Kapılıkaya Rock Tomb in Çorum is an archaeological site dating to 150 BC.
The Abdi İpekçi Peace Monument in Şişli is a sculpture dating to 2000, named after Abdi İpekçi.
Limantepe is an archaeological site in Urla, in the İskele neighbourhood on the seashore; it was settled throughout the Bronze Age.
The Ahmediye Mosque (Üsküdar) in İstanbul is a mosque in Ottoman style.
Tygnis Fortress in Kars is a fortress from the 9th century, built by the Pakraduni dynasty.
The Nişancı Mehmet Pasha Mosque in İstanbul is a mosque in Ottoman style.
Ardanuç Castle in Artvin is a castle dating to the 5th century.
The Monastery of St. George of Manganes in İstanbul is a monastery from 1042.
The Halki Holy Trinity Monastery in İstanbul is a monastery in Byzantine style.
The Revan Kiosk in Fatih is an Ottoman building from 1635, commissioned by Murad IV and designed by Koca Kasım Ağa, named after the Siege of Revan (1635); it is part of a World Heritage Site (1985).
The Holy Trinity Melkite Greek Catholic Cathedral in İstanbul is a church.
The Ahaldaba Church in Artvin is a monastery.
Kozan Castle in Adana is a castle.
The Basilica Therma (Kral Kızı Hamamı) in Yozgat is an archaeological site in Roman style, on the World Heritage Tentative List (2018).
The Sadullah Pasha Yalı in İstanbul is a waterfront mansion in Ottoman style.
The Ali Pasha Yalı in Beşiktaş is a waterfront mansion from 1781 in Art Nouveau style, designed by Raimondo D'Aronco.
The Green Complex (Complex of Mehmed I) in Bursa is an Ottoman complex from 1420 with an area of 1,748 ha, and is part of a World Heritage Site (2014).
Anavarza Castle in Adana is a castle built by the Roman Empire.
